objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with sudden, unilateral loss of vision.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: About half an hour ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye. It was painless, and I didn’t notice anything going on with my left eye while I was watching TV.
[ASK] Are you experiencing 'Central retinal artery occlusion  '?
Yes, doctor—my right eye vision suddenly went away about 30 minutes ago, and it was completely painless. It happened while I was watching TV, and I haven’t noticed any changes in my left eye.
